newsitem.title: USA: N.Carolina serial killer gets nine death sentences.
newsitem.headline: N.Carolina serial killer gets nine death sentences.

text.p: A North Carolina jury on Wednesday returned nine death sentences on serial killer Henry Wallace -- one for each woman he was convicted of strangling.
Wallace, 31, was found guilty on nine counts of first degree murder on Jan. 7. The jury deliberated for 14 hours over four days before handing down the death sentences.
As the court clerk read them out, Judy Williams, a close friend of the family of victim Shawna Hawk, yelled out "yes." She then leaned forward and began to sob.
George Burrol, a cousin of victim Brandi Henderson, closed his eyes and shook his head.
During his trial, the evidence used against Wallace was his own taped confession to police. Jurors heard Wallace detail how he raped and then strangled the women.
He used a mental illness defence.
Wallace knew each of the women murdered in a 22-month killing spree in Charlotte that ended March 1994, as either a co-worker or acquaintance of his girlfriend.
